I am recruiting a fully funded PhD student to join the Urban Interfaces Lab at the University of Sydney, Australia, as part of my Australian Research Council DECRA project on developing a rapid design toolkit for context-aware external human-machine interfaces (eHMIs)―the communication systems autonomous vehicles use to signal intent to pedestrians in complex urban environments.

The PhD project will investigate context-aware AV–pedestrian interaction using technologies such as haptic feedback, spatial audio, and mixed reality, with the goal of producing new knowledge to support safe and inclusive eHMI design for future autonomous vehicles. I welcome applicants with related HCI interests in XR, urban interaction, multisensory design, or intelligent interfaces.

Scholarship

•

Fully funded PhD (tuition fee offset + stipend)

•

AUD $41,753 per year (tax-free)

•

Preferred start: mid-2026

Candidate profile

•

Excellent Honours or Master’s degree in HCI, Computer Science, or a related field

•

Strong coding skills (Unity or Unreal) and experience with XR technologies

•

Experience with qualitative and quantitative research methods

•

Ideally a first-author publication in HCI or a related venue

If you are interested Please email me your CV and a short research statement (≤250 words) no later than the 15th of March:
Feel free to share this opportunity with students or colleagues who may be interested.
